evals.prompt: Fetch https://example.com/docs/guide as clean Markdown, and explain what options to adjust if an SPA page returns an empty shell or Readability drops the sidebar links.
evals.expected_output: Calls fetch_url(url='https://example.com/docs/guide'), explains switching waitUntil to 'networkidle' (or waitForNavigation=true for redirects) for JS-hydrated SPAs, and setting extractContent=false (or returnText=true for plain innerText) if Readability omits sidebars or tables.
assertions: Uses fetch_url with default Markdown/Readability mode
Recommends waitUntil='networkidle' or waitForNavigation=true for dynamic SPAs
Explains extractContent=false vs returnText=true behavior accurately

evals.prompt: Fetch three changelog URLs at once and extract up to 8000 characters from each page, making sure not to enable browser debug windows on the server.
evals.expected_output: Uses fetch_urls(urls=[...], maxLength=8000) to fetch all three URLs concurrently in one browser context, parses [webpage N begin]/[webpage N end] sections, and keeps debug omitted/false.
assertions: Uses fetch_urls with the urls array and maxLength=8000
Avoids passing debug=true on a headless server

evals.prompt: Deploy fetcher-mcp over Streamable HTTP on port 3000 and diagnose why direct POSTs to /mcp return HTTP 400 'Bad Request: No valid session ID provided'.
evals.expected_output: Explains running with --transport=http --host=0.0.0.0 --port=3000 and notes that /mcp uses stateful StreamableHTTPServerTransport requiring an initial 'initialize' request followed by echoing the returned mcp-session-id header.
assertions: Explains stateful mcp-session-id requirement for HTTP 400 diagnosis
